title: Replay of #26: the board makes no herdr calls, and a worker's own session sweeps while its workers run (issue #18)
notes: Source 8bec2a7 (the parent of PR #26; PR #25, which is items 1, 2 and 5 of #18, is in it), hidden tests from its merge 5492371 (tests/ replaced whole). testsChanged is true: PR #26 changed tests/band.test.tsx, tests/harness.tsx and tests/workers.test.tsx. The issue is assembled from #18's own text: #25 is stated as merged, items 3 and 4 and the acceptance lines are as #18 writes them, and Q4=A is word for word from plan-18-PLAN.md line 236. comments is []. D14 is referenced by PR #26 (its body, its fix round and its review comment) but its text is not recorded in plan-18-PLAN.md, #18 (body or comments) or #25, so the issue does not state it. The reference tests check a worker session's own sweep, which PR #26 added in its fix round: a sweep at start-up and every 60 s while one of its jobs runs (so a dead wait child still gets its report), and no herdr call once all its jobs are reported. The issue does not give this; its item 4 ('No timers in worker sessions') does not mention a sweep. Also not given: a worker session writes no board file under ~/.herdr-agents/board/. These are behaviour, not wording or timing, so they are in notes and not in Acceptance details.
